rules.title: Boston Fair Housing Regulations Prohibiting Source of Income and Rental Assistance Discrimination
rules.requirement: Landlords in Boston are prohibited from discriminating against renters based on their use of rental assistance, including Section 8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers, and veterans vouchers.

coverage.summary: Applies to housing rentals in the City of Boston.

rules.quoted_span: The landlord tells you they don't accept rental assistance. This includes Section 8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers, and veterans vouchers.
